objective: Implement app/services/pdf_export.py (PdfExportService using pdflib_shim, one page per report from queries.report_with_rows), app/services/i18n.py (EN/DE label dictionaries with lookup function), and vendor app/services/pdflib_shim.py (40-line PDF wrapper), plus tests/test_pdf_export.py covering PDF generation and i18n label selection

concepts: i18n label lookup by lang code

inputs: C2 PDF export service spec (inlined below)

frozen_contracts.spec: PdfExportService interface: export_pdf(customer_id: str, report_id: str, lang: str) -> bytes. Fetches report data via app/queries.report_with_rows (never reads _REPORTS directly). Uses pdflib_shim to render one page per report. Returns raw PDF bytes. Raises PdfExportError on failure. lang must be 'en' or 'de'; unknown lang raises ValueError.

non_goals: Do not modify app/queries.py, app/models.py, app/api.py, or app/services/export.py
Do not add report creation or editing — only export of existing reports via report_with_rows
Do not add email delivery or file storage — return bytes only
Do not add languages beyond 'en' and 'de'
Do not add a database or persistence layer for PDFs
implementation_constraints: Python 3.11 stdlib only — pdflib_shim is a vendored file, not a pip package
All report data access must go through app/queries.report_with_rows — never import _REPORTS or _CUSTOMERS directly
i18n labels: dict of dicts {lang: {key: text}} with 'en' and 'de' as top-level keys
export_pdf must validate lang is in {'en', 'de'} before doing any work; raise ValueError for unknown lang
PdfExportError is a custom exception class defined in pdf_export.py

deliverables.what: i18n label module with get_label(key, lang) function
Unit tests for PDF generation, i18n, and error cases

acceptance_tests.description: export_pdf with lang='de' produces different label text than lang='en'
export_pdf with unknown report_id raises PdfExportError

failure_cases.expected_behavior: Raise PdfExportError with message containing the report_id
Raise ValueError before any PDF generation work
Raise PdfExportError wrapping the underlying exception

handoff.notes: PdfExportService.export_pdf is the only public method T01's worker calls. i18n.get_label(key, lang) is used internally by pdf_export.py. pdflib_shim is a self-contained 40-line wrapper with no external deps.

warnings.detail: pdflib_shim API surface is not yet known — the 40-line wrapper is provided by the platform team
warnings.rationale: The shim's exact method names and behavior are unknown until vendored; if the API differs from assumptions, the export service needs adjustment
